messages:
Jordan: deploy-bot finished staged rollout to 20% (eu-west). Quick sanity sampling shows elevated p95 on /v1/embeddings (200ms -> 320ms) and a small 500-burst on /v1/generate from one dedicated pool. @deploy-bot can you paste the synthetic sampler summary? Should we continue to 50%?

deploy-bot: Automated summary: stage=20% region=eu-west
healthcheck: PASS
synthetic-samples: total=1200, failures=9 (0.75%)
errors: 500s=6, 429s=3
p95(/v1/embeddings)=320ms (baseline=200ms)
p95(/v1/generate)=180ms (baseline=170ms)
note: errors localized to pool gpu-dedicated-7
links: http://deploybot/runs/1746604319

Alex: Can someone check whether this correlates with the kernel-selection tweak from earlier? I saw a commit that enabled 'use_fast_attention' on the embed path.

Mia: Good call. I ran a quick grep in the logs — see below.
```
2026-03-20T14:45:12Z model-serving: kernel select=fast_attn, variant=quant-int8
2026-03-20T14:45:17Z cache: prefix_miss spike=+18%
2026-03-20T14:45:18Z inference: p95_embed=310ms
```

Priya: Oncall: not firing SRE pager yet (threshold 1% failures or p95>400ms for 5m). My recommendation: HOLD rollout at 20%, re-run synthetic sampler with focused traffic (5k samples) against the embed route + rerun KV warmup, then decide. If failures persist after sampling, we revert to previous deployment.

Sam: We can toggle kernel selection remotely for that pool. Suggest try disabling fast_attn in gpu-dedicated-7 as a scoped experiment before full rollback. Command:
```
rbctl pool update gpu-dedicated-7 --set kernel.fast_attn=false
```

Jordan: Agree with scoped toggle. @deploy-bot run focused sampler (5k) on gpu-dedicated-7 after toggle and report within 10m.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Scheduling focused sampler -> 5k requests -> target=pool:gpu-dedicated-7. ETA ~6m. Will post summary.

Mia: Quick note: if we toggle kernel, maybe warmup KV cache again: `rbctl warmup --pool gpu-dedicated-7 --prefixes 1000`

deploy-bot: Focused sampler complete: total=5000, failures=12 (0.24%), p95(/v1/embeddings)=205ms, errors 500s=1, cache-miss normalized. Action: kernel.fast_attn=false on gpu-dedicated-7 appears to mitigate. No rollback required. Recommend continue gradual rollout to 50% and monitor 10m.

Jordan: Copy. Proceed to 50% in 10m if metrics hold. Thanks all :thumbsup:
